verdict.rationale: An ecosystem of partner-built agent apps is a fair question for a coding agent, but Aider's evidence shows no marketplace, plugin system, or documented way to plug third-party agent apps into its workflows. The only related items do not count: the Python scripting API is an unsupported developer building block, a community-built 'navigator-mode' is a user-side extension, and Dosu's interest runs the other way (embedding Aider in another product).

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
